approach: Convert the plane's speed to SI units, find the fall time from the height using g = 9.8 m/s², then multiply to get the horizontal distance covered.

steps.text: Convert the horizontal speed from km/h to m/s.
Find the time to fall the given height from rest, using g = 9.8 m/s².
The dropped body keeps the plane's horizontal velocity throughout the fall, so the horizontal distance AB equals speed times time.

common_mistakes.text: Using 600 directly as the speed in m/s without converting from km/h, giving a wrong distance of 600×20 = 12000 m.
